data.narrative:
RISE Robotics is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company founded by Arron Acosta and Blake Sessions, having raised $22M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 9 private robotics firms and 1 public comparable (277810.KQ), anchored on peers spanning seed to Series B stages including Humanoid ($1.4B, Series A), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), and Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses the $22M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-later-stage step-ups, yielding $44M. The peer-median approach samples five same-sector and same/adjacent-stage companies with a median valuation of $1.6B and range of $1.1B to $2.0B, reflecting the wide dispersion typical of early-stage robotics valuations.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $37M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $847M. The wide spread reflects substantial uncertainty inherent in early-stage robotics investing: RISE's stage and funding to date anchor toward the lower end ($37M–$44M), while peer comparables—many at later stages—suggest materially higher valuations. Key uncertainties include revenue traction relative to peers, competitive differentiation, and customer adoption velocity in robotics and manufacturing applications.
